name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 74 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 74 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israel continues airstrikes in Gaza, killing two terrorists linked to Doctors Without Borders and targeting Hamas chief al-Hayya's son, who survived the strike. Hamas chief's last surviving son also escaped an Israeli attack in Gaza City. The Israeli security cabinet is set to discuss advancing the stalled Trump Gaza plan amid US pressure, while Abbas is preparing to label Hamas a terror group, paving the way for an Eisenkot coalition. The UN warns the Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development and deepening hunger across the Middle East. 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel fortsetter luftangrep i Gaza, og dreper to terrorister knyttet til Leger uten grenser, samtidig som de retter seg mot Hamas-sjefens sønn al-Hayya, som overlevde angrepet. Hamas-sjefens siste overlevende sønn unnslapp også et israelsk angrep i Gaza-by. Det israelske sikkerhetsrådet skal diskutere å fremme den fastlåste Trump-planen for Gaza under press fra USA, mens Abbas forbereder å klassifisere Hamas som en terrororganisasjon, noe som legger til rette for en Eisenkot-koalisjon. FN advarer om at Gaza-krigen har tilbakestilt 77 år med menneskelig utvikling og forverrer sulten i Midtøsten. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its closest supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
